name: section
description: Full-width page section with a surface tone, vertical rhythm and an optional centered container.
designIntent: Marketing and content pages alternate background bands and vertical padding. Section owns the band and the inner container so pages stop repeating py-* and background classes, and tone="inverse" scopes the token ladder for a readable dark band.

props.name: tone
props.description: Surface treatment. inverse flips background, foreground, card, border and muted tokens for its subtree.

props.name: padding
props.description: Vertical rhythm. md is py-14 / sm:py-16.

props.name: container
props.description: Wrap children in a centered Container.

props.name: containerClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the inner Container.

examples.title: Inverse CTA band
examples.code:
<Section tone="inverse" padding="lg">
  <SectionHeading title="Ready to exit?" align="center" />
</Section>
examples.description: A dark band whose child components inherit inverse surface tokens.

examples.title: Muted feature band
examples.description: A tinted band with a wider content cap.

antiPatterns.title: Don't put a Section inside a Section
antiPatterns.explanation: Nesting bands doubles padding and can reset the tone. Use one Section per band and plain layout elements inside it.

antiPatterns.title: Don't hardcode colors inside a tone
antiPatterns.explanation: Use semantic tokens so the inverse scope can flip card, border and muted text automatically.

accessibility.implementation: tone=inverse sets background, foreground, card, border and muted CSS variables on the section
accessibility.userRequirements: Keep text and controls on semantic tokens so contrast survives the tone change

accessibility.implementation: Renders a section element by default
accessibility.userRequirements: Add aria-label or aria-labelledby when the section is a named region

guidelines: Use inverse once per page for the final CTA
goodExamples: Default features, muted proof, inverse CTA
badExamples: Five alternating dark bands in a row

compositionRules.relationship: Section renders Container when container is true
Hero is placed inside Section; Section owns the band
